newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Far Eastern hits intra-day price rise limit.
newsitem.headline: Far Eastern hits intra-day price rise limit.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) had frozen any further price rise of Far Eastern University shares at 375 pesos after hitting the 50 percent daily fluctuation limit, a bourse official said on Friday.
Only 70 shares had been traded when the price hit 375 pesos, up from the previous close of 250 pesos.
Far Eastern University is one of the market's more illiquid stocks and bourse officials have asked it to explain the sharp price hike. University officials were not immediately available for comment.
